No masterclass

28.6k views a reel, then a list of links

Someone who likes a reel lands on a Linktree with more than ten choices. Nothing walks him from “I like this guy” to “I want his help”.

No qualifying step

The VIP buyer is a stranger until he pays

$2,600 coaching is bought straight from a checkout page. There is no application, so you can’t spot the serious men early or nurture the ones who are close.

Content-dependent

Sales follow your posting schedule

8 posts in 7 days keeps the lights on. Nothing runs every day on its own, so the week you post less is the week sales slow down.

Your audience already trusts you. What’s missing is one front door that turns that trust into sales every day, whether you posted or not.

You already have the products. A free class, fed daily by Meta ads, puts them in front of thousands of new men, shows you who is serious about VIP coaching, and the bundle sales pay for the ads.

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The fastest way to lose a great match? Texting for two weeks.”

Body

“Chat is for logistics. Clear, friendly, then a simple plan with a day and a place. A man who can plan an easy first date stands out straight away.”

CTA

“I break down exactly how in my free Modern Gentleman Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “plan the date” highlighted in gold.
